BURNINGMOD-FIRESTARTER.title: Firestarter
BURNINGMOD-FIRESTARTER.description: At the start of combat and turn 2, apply 1 [gold]Burn[/gold] to yourself and 2 [gold]Burn[/gold] to ALL enemies.
BURNINGMOD-FIRESTARTER.flavor: Every great fire begins with a single spark.
BURNINGMOD-PYROMANIA_BRAND.title: Pyromania Brand
BURNINGMOD-PYROMANIA_BRAND.description: Whenever you play [blue]Inflame[/blue], [blue]Burning Pact[/blue], or [blue]Infernal Blade[/blue], apply 1 [gold]Burn[/gold] to yourself and 2 [gold]Burn[/gold] to ALL enemies.
BURNINGMOD-PYROMANIA_BRAND.flavor: Branded by flame, obsessed by it.
BURNINGMOD-PHOENIX_ASH.title: Phoenix Ash
BURNINGMOD-PHOENIX_ASH.description: After combat victory, heal HP equal to your [gold]Burn[/gold] stacks when you land the killing blow.
BURNINGMOD-EMBER_FLASK.title: Ember Flask
BURNINGMOD-EMBER_FLASK.description: Whenever you use a Potion, apply 3 [gold]Burn[/gold] to ALL enemies.
BURNINGMOD-EMBER_FLASK.flavor: The heat inside never quite goes out.
BURNINGMOD-CINDER_SHARD.title: Cinder Shard
BURNINGMOD-CINDER_SHARD.description: The first card you exhaust each turn applies 3 [gold]Burn[/gold] to a random enemy.
BURNINGMOD-SHIV_SMELTER.title: Shiv Smelter
BURNINGMOD-SHIV_SMELTER.description: At the start of your first two turns of combat, add 2 [gold]Burning Shiv[/gold]s to your hand.
BURNINGMOD-FIRE_MASK.title: Fire Mask
BURNINGMOD-FIRE_MASK.description: Whenever a [gold]Sly[/gold] card triggers, apply 2 [gold]Burn[/gold] to ALL enemies.
BURNINGMOD-VENOM_COIL.title: Venom Coil
BURNINGMOD-VENOM_COIL.description: At the start of combat, apply 3 [gold]Poison[/gold] to ALL enemies. When a Poisoned enemy dies, apply their remaining [gold]Poison[/gold] as [gold]Burn[/gold] to a random enemy.
BURNINGMOD-SLAG_PROCESSOR.title: Slag Processor
BURNINGMOD-SLAG_PROCESSOR.description: The first Status you draw each turn is Exhausted. Draw 1 card and apply 2 [gold]Burn[/gold] to a random enemy.
BURNINGMOD-SEARING_MARK.title: Searing Mark
BURNINGMOD-SEARING_MARK.description: The first time you apply a debuff to an enemy each turn, also apply 2 [gold]Burn[/gold] to them.
BURNINGMOD-SEARING_MARK.flavor: It leaves more than a scar.
BURNINGMOD-FORGE_CORE.title: Forge Core
BURNINGMOD-FORGE_CORE.description: At the start of combat, Channel 1 [gold]Fire Orb[/gold].
BURNINGMOD-MAGMA_HEART.title: Magma Heart
BURNINGMOD-MAGMA_HEART.description: The first [gold]Fire Orb[/gold] you Channel each combat is replaced by an [gold]Inferno Orb[/gold].
BURNINGMOD-MAGMA_HEART.flavor: Hotter than fire. Deeper than stone.
